title: Use Overall System Bag Out Control to close destinations and exchange totes by sorter leg
summary: Use the bag out (auto bagger) control labeled “Overall System Bag Out Control” to close all destinations and exchange all totes that contain parcels. If you need to limit scope, select the option to bag out by leg of the sorter.
when_to_use: When you are running bag out (auto bagger) and need to close destinations and exchange totes containing parcels. Use the “Overall System Bag Out Control” option for system-wide bag out, or use “bag out by leg of the sorter” to limit the scope.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Initiate the bag out action using the “Overall System Bag Out Control” UI/control and select the intended scope (all destinations vs by leg).
access_or_tools_needed: Bag out (auto bagger) control UI that includes “Overall System Bag Out Control”
UI visibility into destinations and exchange task scope/status

visual_references.description: UI figure showing “Overall System Bag Out Control” and the options: close all destinations & exchange all totes with parcels; optionally bag out by leg of the sorter; plus manual bag out notes (cancel bag out) and pre bag out exchanges lowest 25% per leg.

steps.title: Locate the “Overall System Bag Out Control” UI/control in the bag out (auto bagger) area
steps.purpose: Find the control that drives system bag out behavior (close destinations and exchange totes with parcels).
steps.instruction: Open the bag out (auto bagger) control UI and locate the control labeled “Overall System Bag Out Control”.
steps.expected_result: The “Overall System Bag Out Control” control is visible on the bag out (auto bagger) UI, including the options for system bag out and bag out by leg of the sorter.
steps.healthy_condition: The UI shows “Overall System Bag Out Control” with the described options (system-wide close/exchange and the leg-scoped option).
steps.failure_condition: The “Overall System Bag Out Control” control (or its described options) is not available/visible in the bag out (auto bagger) UI.

steps.purpose: Limit bag out scope to a specific sorter leg when required.
